name: Homomorphic-Encrypted Volume Rendering
aliases: Direct volume rendering on encrypted data
Paillier Homomorphic Encryption for Volume Rendering
definition: Direct volume rendering performed entirely on encrypted volume data using homomorphic encryption, ensuring data and rendered image are uninterpretable to the rendering server.
summary: Homomorphic-Encrypted Volume Rendering performs ray casting on Paillier-encrypted data, allowing untrusted servers to render images without accessing plaintext voxel values.
